The planned expansion of the Facility was to include a headworks influent screen and parallel treatment trains, a disinfection system, recycled water use areas, and unlined storage ponds for undisinfected effluent.
The storage ponds for undisinfected effluent were planned to be constructed at the location of the existing ponds.
Board, prescribed waste discharge requirements for the Facility to four evaporation/percolation ponds and envisioned expansion of the Facility to accommodate planned development projects.
